description: Starts a run: everything one job creates, grouped in your account. The run comes with its own isolated private network (internet access, no route to your other networks; its id is network_id in the result): create the run's machines with start_machine: the platform prepares them in that network, sized for the run, often already booted and waiting. Pass the run's id as run_id to create_volume and create_private_network; each resource joins the run. When the job is done, end_run deletes everything in the run, its network included, and checks each one gone. The network and the machines are billed as usual. network: false makes a run without a network of its own (it then cannot get machines).

name.description: Optional short name for the run, e.g. nightly-eval.

network.description: Default true: the run gets its own isolated private network, deleted with the run. false: no network of its own; put its machines on networks you already have.

name: create_run
title: Create run
